PRE_REGISTRATION.licence: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT -- exploration. No significance gate, no MDE, no multiplicity control, and correspondingly NO claim of alpha. PIT discipline, absent target leakage, non-zero costs and frozen walk-forward splits do NOT relax.
PRE_REGISTRATION.question: Does a family of 13F-ownership or analyst-identity features add OUT-OF-SAMPLE value to a learner that already sees price, consensus, revisions, coverage and the band prior?
PRE_REGISTRATION.primary_metric: the PAIRED monthly difference in cross-sectional rank IC between the family model and the base model, t across MONTHS (CANON 58 -- date blocks, never name-months).
PRE_REGISTRATION.secondary: terminal wealth of a monthly top-50 value-weighted book net of 10 bps/side on measured weight turnover; decile spread.
PRE_REGISTRATION.decision_rule: a family that does not raise the paired delta IC above zero at BOTH horizons and for BOTH model kinds is recorded as adding nothing. A negative is recorded as a negative and not smoothed into 'directionally encouraging'.

known_data_caveats.sic_9999_is_unknown_not_an_industry: A sibling session measured that 22.5% of the training panel's rows (99,334/441,278) carry CRSP siccd 9999, which is NONCLASSIFIABLE and is mislabelled 'Public Administration' in the shared sector mapping. No feature in THIS module conditions on the panel's `sector` column. The one place it touches SIC at all is indirect: `h_specialist_frac` and `x_specialist_x_thincov` read `sector_entropy` from `holder_fingerprints.parquet`, which is a filer-level entropy over CRSP SIC-2 codes -- so a filer concentrated in the 99 bucket reads as 'concentrated' when it is in fact concentrated in UNKNOWN. That inflates the specialist flag for such filers and is a reason to read the specialist features as noisier than the rest of the holder family, not as a sector claim. The shared mapping is not edited here; the central fix is queued elsewhere.

complete_case.rule: every extension feature present, except four that are structurally null on a name's first observed quarter or with a single covering analyst (h_top_holder_log_chg, h_n_holders_chg_pct, h_inst_own_chg, a_bias_disp)

null_shuffled_within_month_1m.reads: the training target was permuted WITHIN each month, so the cross-sectional pairing is destroyed while the calendar, the market factor and the whole pipeline are untouched. A non-zero IC here would be a leak in the plumbing, not a signal.

lgbm_gain_shares_1m.reads: gain says what the model USED, never what it EARNED.

terminal_wealth_deltas_are_NOT_paired_te.what: `delta_terminal_wealth_net` is reported for every family cell and is NOT accompanied by a paired test. A difference of two terminal wealths is ONE draw of a correlated pair -- the exact error `learner/evaluate.book` warns about when it prints the paired monthly excess beside the wealth number.
terminal_wealth_deltas_are_NOT_paired_te.why_it_does_not_overturn_the_verdict: The BASE book itself does not significantly beat the market over the same months, so every wealth delta is noise measured on top of noise. The primary metric (paired monthly rank-IC difference) IS tested and is negative in 16 of 16 cells.
terminal_wealth_deltas_are_NOT_paired_te.the_fix: difference the two books MONTH BY MONTH and t the difference (`evaluate.book(..., return_series=True)` already returns the monthly net series, and `evaluate.hac_t` / `evaluate.block_t` handle the 12m overlap). Queued, not done here.

holder_public_date_is_conservative.what: A name's 13F aggregate is stamped public only once the LAST of that name's filers is public, and a cumulative max stops a later report quarter from ever looking public earlier than an earlier one.
holder_public_date_is_conservative.cost: 91% of panel rows carry zero extra lag; the rest are 1-4 quarters stale (see panels.holder_build.public_lag_quarters). The bias is toward LESS information, never toward more.

thomson_vintage_check_did_not_pass_clean.what: 2,156 of 45,018,857 positions (0.005%) carry a Thomson vintage LATER than their report quarter, so `vintage_reduction_valid` is FALSE and the public date does NOT reduce to quarter_end+45d on every row. It is handled rather than ignored: those rows push their name's public date out to the later vintage, which is why the lag table above is not all zeros. A gate that reports FALSE and is acted on is working.

specialist_features_read_sic_9999_as_an_.what: `h_specialist_frac` and `x_specialist_x_thincov` derive from the fingerprint's `sector_entropy`, an entropy over CRSP SIC-2 codes in which 99 (NONCLASSIFIABLE) is a bucket like any other. A filer concentrated in UNKNOWN reads as concentrated.
specialist_features_read_sic_9999_as_an_.effect: read the two specialist features as noisier than the rest of the family.

null_bar_addendum_20260903.reads: the shuffled null in this receipt is ONE draw (or a per-draw re-randomising permutation) and was originally read against a |t| < 2 bar. S36 measured that bar as mis-specified: a model fitted on noise holds one persistent tilt, its naive t spans -9..+12 across seeds, so |t| < 2 on one draw is close to a coin flip and a re-randomising null cannot catch a persistent tilt. The null here remains valid as a LEAK check only. Skill claims owe the model-null percentile: >= 64 fitted-on-shuffled draws (learner/nullbar.py; measured for v2 in learner_v2_20260903.json's model_null_distribution).
